plan.title: Spire Climb
plan.tagline: Hop the spiral, ring the bell — a cozy cat's climb above the clouds.
plan.core_loop: Hop up ledges, rope bridges and rotating platforms around a spiral tower, grabbing stardust and checkpoint flags on the way, until you ring the great bell at the top.
controls: Hold jump mid-air: glide (with Scarf Glide)
plan.win_condition: Ring the great bell on the spire platform at the top of the tower.
plan.lose_condition: Lose all 3 lives by falling into the cloud sea below.

mechanics.name: Nimble Paws
mechanics.text: Milo is nimble: a springier jump and one air-hop for the tight ledges.

mechanics.name: Scarf Glide
mechanics.text: Scarf Glide: hold jump in the air to drift across the cloud gaps.

mechanics.name: Star Chirp
mechanics.text: Every 8 stardust: +50 and a happy chirp!

plan.art_direction: A cozy pastel world above the clouds: warm cream and peach stone, sage moss, honey-wood bridges and a dusty-peach sky at golden hour. Soft rounded voxel shapes with gentle ink outlines, glowing amber lanterns and a warm rim light like late afternoon. References: Ghibli sky meadows, Animal Crossing softness, Monument Valley color blocking.
concept_shots: A chibi orange cat with a sage scarf leaps from a mossy stone ledge onto a rope bridge, the spiral of floating pillars rising behind it and a sea of clouds far below.
A rotating wooden platform carries the cat across a wide cloud gap toward a lantern-lit tower tier, stardust motes twinkling along the route.
The cat rings the big golden bell on the spire platform as confetti bursts and warm light spills over the whole spiral tower wrapped in sunset clouds.

assets.sky: Golden hour above a cloud sea: peach-to-lavender gradient, a big warm sun low on the horizon, puffy cumulus far below, first stars twinkling.

plan.mapping_notes: No preset level kind is a vertical spiral tower above the clouds — sky_islands is a horizontal hop between islands, and floating_castle is a keep-and-bridge castle, not a spiral climb — so use custom with the kit's own spiral_climb example (a spiral of pillars around a tall tower above the clouds), which is exactly the pitch's space. The bell at the top becomes the goal portal on the spire; the cozy look + golden-hour sky carries the 'cozy above the clouds' mood; the cat hero is the kit's cat species with a scarf accessory; the rotating platforms are Level movers with rotate motion; falling into the cloud sea is the void hazard with 3 lives.
features: Checkpoint flags at each tier of the spiral — fall and respawn where you last flagged (Gameplay.rules checkpoints)
Rotating stone platforms and a ping-pong cloud raft between tiers (Level movers: rotate / pingpong)
Void below the cloud sea: falling costs a life and drops you back at the last checkpoint (hazard: void)
Scarf Glide power-up pickups mid-climb (Mechanics powerup: glide)
Sparkle burst and floating '+1' text on every stardust pickup (FX.sparkle + FX.text)
Confetti, warm flash and a big bell chime the moment the bell is rung (FX.confetti + FX.flash + win SFX)

result.summary: Spire Climb: a cozy spiral-tower platformer above the clouds. Built on the scaffold: hand-laid spiral route (10 mossy pillars around the tower core), a rotating stone beam and a ping-pong cloud raft between tiers, a rope bridge to the spire, and a bell platform as the goal. Cat hero with scarf, cozy look + generated golden-hour sky, lantern/bell props and splat landmarks, stardust collectibles (24, target 8), 3 lives with void fall-death, checkpoint flags per tier. Signature mechanics wired: Nimble Paws (tune: springier jump + air-hop), Scarf Glide (3 glide power-ups along the route), Star Chirp (every 8 stardust: +50 and a banner). Cozy HUD with stardust counter, hearts, minimap and objective; title screen sells the fantasy; FX.auto + Audio.auto give sparkles, confetti, bell chime and music.
changes: Rebuilt LAYOUT by hand: start island, tower core, 10-pillar spiral, rotating 'rotate' mover beam (tier 1), ping-pong cloud raft (tier 2), rope bridge to the spire, mossy step pillar and a 5.5u bell platform as the goal
Tuned the rotating beam's sweep so the jump off it is within the 5u/2.5u limits (no more autofix stepping platform)
HUD: added objective line 'Ring the great bell at the top of the spire'
Title screen credit line now matches the plan's controls (move / jump + air-hop + scarf glide / pause)
known_issues: Autopilot only reached ~10/24 stardust and the tower mid-climb in a 12 s test (level is a long vertical climb; it was still progressing with no deaths or errors)
The plan's twist mechanic (e.g. a custom rule) was not added — the three signature mechanics from the plan are all wired and firing instead

incidents: a duplicate builder process of the same pipeline ran 04:48-04:52 on this run dir and was killed; game.js was not written during that window, so it most likely has none of its writes
